The Trusted Online Shopping Store in Pakistan

Telemart is Pakistan's 2nd largest ecommerce marketplace and the country's largest tech retail company, with 39 stores across 26 cities. Founded in 2012 by Ahmed Rauf Essa, who serves as the Founder & CEO, Telemart has transformed the online shopping experience by offering millions of customers access to authentic products, competitive prices, nationwide delivery, and exceptional customer service. Today, Telemart is recognized as one of Pakistan's most trusted online shopping destinations and is the only brand in Pakistan to receive 2 National Awards and 12 Global Awards, reflecting its commitment to innovation, customer satisfaction, and excellence in retail.

At Telemart, customers can explore one of Pakistan's largest collections of mobile phones, smartphones, 5G mobiles, Android phones, iPhones, Samsung mobiles, Xiaomi mobiles, OPPO mobiles, Vivo mobiles, Infinix mobiles, Tecno mobiles, Realme mobiles, Google Pixel phones, OnePlus phones, and feature phones. Whether you're searching for the latest flagship smartphone, budget mobile phone, gaming phone, camera phone, PTA approved mobiles, or the best mobile phone deals in Pakistan, Telemart offers genuine products with official warranties, installment plans, exchange offers, and competitive prices.

Discover an extensive range of wireless earbuds, Bluetooth earbuds, AirPods, noise cancelling earbuds, gaming earbuds, Bluetooth headphones, wireless headphones, headsets, portable Bluetooth speakers, home audio systems, and premium audio accessories from the world's leading brands. Whether you need earbuds for work, gaming, fitness, travel, or everyday entertainment, Telemart provides high-quality audio products for every lifestyle.

Explore Pakistan's latest collection of smart watches, fitness trackers, Apple Watch, Samsung Galaxy Watch, Huawei Watch, Xiaomi Smart Band, smart bands, health monitoring watches, and sports wearables designed to help you stay connected, track your fitness, monitor your health, and improve your productivity. Shop original smart wearables at affordable prices with nationwide delivery.

Photography enthusiasts can browse an extensive collection of DSLR cameras, mirrorless cameras, digital cameras, action cameras, security cameras, dash cams, IP cameras, camera lenses, camera accessories, tripods, gimbals, and photography equipment from globally recognized brands. Whether you're a professional photographer, content creator, YouTuber, or beginner, Telemart offers the latest camera technology for every need.

Telemart also features one of Pakistan's fastest-growing fashion marketplaces with premium collections of men's clothing, women's clothing, kids wear, western wear, eastern wear, footwear, sneakers, running shoes, sandals, handbags, wallets, fashion accessories, watches, sunglasses, jewelry, perfumes, beauty products, cosmetics, and personal care essentials. Shop the latest fashion trends from trusted local and international brands at unbeatable prices.

For home and office needs, customers can shop a comprehensive selection of home appliances, kitchen appliances, small appliances, large appliances, refrigerators, washing machines, air conditioners, microwave ovens, vacuum cleaners, water dispensers, air fryers, blenders, juicers, coffee machines, rice cookers, electric kettles, room heaters, air purifiers, and smart home solutions from leading manufacturers.
